title: Medical Check-Up for Prospective Migrant Workers
intro:
Prospective Indonesian Migrant Workers (PMI) are Indonesian citizens who meet the requirements to work overseas and are officially registered with the local government agency responsible for employment, in accordance with the established procedures and regulations.

Working abroad is one of the most popular career choices for many Indonesians. However, some individuals still become non-procedural migrant workers, meaning they do not follow the official recruitment process or meet the required legal and administrative requirements.

req_body:
Prospective Indonesian Migrant Workers who plan to work overseas must meet the following requirements: be at least 18 years of age, have the required skills or competencies, be physically and mentally fit, be registered with the Indonesian Social Security Program (BPJS), and possess all required supporting documents.

Amalia Medical Center provides overseas Medical Check-Up services for applicants traveling to ASEAN countries, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and China.

All Medical Check-Up packages can be tailored to the applicant's destination country and the required examination package.

Documents Required for Medical Check-Up
Please prepare the following:
doc_1: A photocopy of your passport and Indonesian ID card (KTP)
doc_2: One recent passport-sized photograph (3 × 4 cm or 4 × 6 cm) with a red or blue background
doc_3: Any supporting documents required for your application
doc_4: Get adequate rest, drink plenty of water, and avoid coffee and alcohol before your Medical Check-Up
doc_5: Choose Amalia Medical Center for your Medical Check-Up
exam_body:
The Medical Check-Up consists of three main components: blood and urine sample collection, chest X-ray examination, and physical examination by a physician.

Medical Check-Up fees vary depending on the destination country. Basic packages start from IDR 250,000.

Our team is committed to providing reliable, efficient, and professional Medical Check-Up services to support your overseas employment requirements.
